name: (12) Protean — 3 Advanced — Purify the Impaled Breast

system.description:
With a convulsion of will you expel every foreign thing lodged in your flesh — bullets, splinters, dirt, even a stake driven through your heart — hurling them outward with great force.

Spend two Blood Traits, or three if a stake through the heart has incapacitated you; the power works even while staked. Everyone in the line of fire must win a Physical Challenge against a number of Traits equal to your Protean rating for each object expelled, or take one bashing health level per object that strikes them (even bullets or knives inflict only bashing). By spending a Willpower Trait you may choose to leave some objects in place — fully or partially embedded, such as a stake left jutting from your breastbone to fool your opponents.
